note: Adjudicated accidental variants (punctuation). It is a typographical slip of that one setting, not a reading: do has princípio, and the same edition sets the same doxology correctly on its printed page 12 at the Lavábo. The transcription in witnesses/ordinarium.iudica-me/handmissal-eo.txt therefore reads princípio and says so in its header. Nothing else on the page is altered, and collation of the letters is otherwise at zero divergence.
